name: Bankai - Ryujin Jakka
description: (Tag:bound)(Tag:fire)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:weapon)Ryujin Jakka's Bankai, a burnt blade whose power and heat scale with the user, granting four directional abilities: East concentrates all flames in the blade for maximum destruction, West cloaks the body in extreme defensive heat, South raises slain corpses as puppets, and North unleashes all power in a superheated slash. (A/N: Does not give spiritual energy, cannot be evolved).
